title: Lightning Transportation Reporting Agent Correction Event
description: The single webhook payload for a user correction to a reporting agent. Send only sanitized content.

event_id.description: A newly generated UUID for this correction event.

occurred_at.description: UTC time when the user correction was received.

user_question_or_task.description: The user's question or task, preserving meaning but redacting protected personal data, credentials, and unnecessary identifiers.

user_correction.description: The user's correction or feedback, sanitized using the same rules.

agent_answer_summary.description: Brief sanitized summary of the answer that was corrected; null when unavailable.

proposed_learning.description: General rule the agent believes may need documentation; null until known. This is never an approved change by itself.

affected_docs.description: Candidate documentation files; empty until triage is complete.

redactions.description: Categories removed, such as pii, credential, session, or unnecessary_identifier.

test_mode.description: True only for an explicitly labeled, non-production delivery test.
